facts.fact: The e-Governance Academy says a solution called "authentication for another" is used in Benin's service centres to help people without equipment or skills reach services.

BEN.note: No civil register or ID link stated.
Skills effort named is for remote villages, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The e-Governance Academy and ASIN's head of eServices say the X-Road data exchange platform has been implemented in Benin as the interoperability infrastructure behind its e-services.

BEN.note: No count of connected bodies or usage figure.

facts.fact: The e-Governance Academy says Benin launched a citizen portal and e-services including a civil-servant pension service, building permits, traffic exams and university applications.

BEN.note: No count of ten or more, sign-in or usage figure.
No ID enrolment count or share stated.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: ASIN's head of eServices says the agency implemented the X-Road data exchange platform in Benin and adapted it to the country's needs.
The e-Governance Academy says ASIN runs the interoperability infrastructure and e-services platform and encourages government agencies to use it.

BEN.note: No system stated as live after October 2023.
